guidance_fy27.src: Q4 FY26 release (8-K Ex. 99.1, 8-Jun-2026); reaffirmed in the Q1 FY27 release (8-K Ex. 99.1, 6-Aug-2026)
guidance_fy27.items_note: Adjusted EBITDA guidance excludes ~$5.5-6.5m of equity-based compensation, net acquisition & integration costs and ERP conversion costs (Q1 FY27 release; $4.0-5.0m in the Q4 FY26 release). SG&A guidance (incl. amortization) includes ~$4.0-5.0m of those items.
guidance_fy27.invest: ~$2.5m of incremental FY2027 costs to invest in people, processes and technology (included in SG&A and Adjusted EBITDA guidance).

investor_day.roic: >20% enterprise ROIC (top quartile); >20% ROIC hurdle on organic investments
investor_day.flacktek_fy27: FlackTek: expect ~$30 million of revenue and ~$3 million of Adjusted EBITDA in FY2027; $25 million of potential earnouts tied to progressively increasing EBITDA targets FY2027-FY2030.
investor_day.capital: Capex 7-10% of sales and R&D 1-2% of sales (organic growth); M&A as an accelerator with leverage <3.0x (Q4 FY26 presentation, 8-K Ex. 99.3, 8-Jun-2026).

flacktek.sales_src: FY2026 10-K Note 2 (net sales of FlackTek included in FY2026: $2,767 thousand, i.e. 23-Jan to 31-Mar-2026); Q1 FY27 10-Q MD&A (FlackTek added $6,551 thousand to Q1 FY27 net sales).
flacktek.market_share_note: Assumption: allocation of FlackTek sales across the company's markets (not disclosed by market). The Q4 FY26 presentation says FlackTek's $3m was 'primarily Energy & Process'; the Q1 FY27 release says its contribution was across all markets.
flacktek.consideration: Purchase price $37,022 thousand (FY2026 10-K): cash $26,456 thousand + 76 thousand shares ($5,678 thousand at $74.89) + contingent earn-out at fair value $5,638 thousand (up to $25,000 thousand, FY2027-FY2030 adjusted EBITDA targets). Q1 FY27 working-capital settlement: $1,567 thousand cash received; purchase price reduced to $36,205 thousand and goodwill by $752 thousand (Q1 FY27 10-Q Note 2).
flacktek.earnout_liability: Contingent earn-out liabilities $7,059 thousand at 30-Jun-2026 ($3,967 thousand current), after a $577 thousand fair-value increase in Q1 FY27 (10-Q Note 2).

amort_sched.src: Q1 FY27 10-Q Note 5: estimated annual amortization of intangibles held at 30-Jun-2026 (fiscal years ending 31 March); excludes the FlackTek inventory step-up ($95 thousand in Q1 FY27).

debt.facility: Wells Fargo revolving credit facility (5-year, 13-Oct-2023; matures Oct-2028), increased from $50,000 to $80,000 thousand on 23-Jan-2026; $25,000 thousand letter-of-credit sub-limit. SOFR + 1.25-2.50% (1.25% fixed for the first year), unused fee 0.10-0.20%. Covenants: total leverage <= 3.50x, fixed-charge coverage >= 1.20x (FY2026 10-K Note 9).
debt.at_2026_06_30: No borrowings; $5,520 thousand of letters of credit; $74,480 thousand available (Q1 FY27 10-Q Note 7). $13,000 thousand repaid in April 2026 from the PIPE proceeds.
debt.pipe: Securities Purchase Agreement 14-Apr-2026 (8-K 15-Apr-2026): 600 thousand shares to accounts advised by T. Rowe Price at $83.36 (20-day average close) = $50,000 thousand gross (Q1 FY27 10-Q Note 6).

buyback: Stock repurchase program authorized 29-Jan-2015 for up to $18,000 thousand; no shares purchased in FY2024-FY2026 (FY2026 10-K Note 16) or Q1 FY27 (10-Q Part II Item 2: none).
dividend: Quarterly dividend suspended in Q4 FY2022 (FY2023 10-K Item 5); none paid FY2023-Q1 FY27.

price.note: Form 4s filed 10-Jun-2026 (Malone, Thome, Thoren): shares withheld for taxes on 8-Jun-2026 at $95.34 - the latest share price in an SEC filing (later Form 4s of Aug/Sep-2026 report unpriced grants); update to market.

splits: 2-for-1 (declared 28-Jul-2005, before the history window), 5-for-4 effective 3-Jan-2008 (declared 26-Oct-2007) and 2-for-1 effective 6-Oct-2008 (declared 31-Jul-2008): FY2009 10-K Item 5 and Item 6 note. Releases dated before 3-Jan-2008 are restated x2.5, before 6-Oct-2008 x2.
tax: Statutory tax rate used by the company for the tax effect of adjustments: 23% (federal 21% + state); 'normalize tax rate to 19%/20%' in FY2022. FY2026 ETR 15.3% (R&D credits, share-based compensation; FY2026 10-K Note 11).
